sloka: ततः स कर्मणा तस्य विस्मितो भीमविक्रमः ।हनुमान् रोषताम्राक्षो रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत ।। ५.४९.१।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa karmaṇā tasya vismito bhīmavikramaḥ ।hanumān roṣatāmrākṣo rakṣodhipamavaikṣata ।। 5.49.1।।।।

translations.english: The highly courageous Hanuman, astonished at the action (of binding and dragging him to the court) by the demon king looked at him with eyes turned red in anger.
